name: note2md
description: Agent-native Markdown note management with Notebook→Section→Page hierarchy. Slash commands: /n2m:init, /n2m:newnotebook, /n2m:newpage, /n2m:newtemplate, /n2m:archive, /n2m:securecheck, and more. Smart templates learned from your own notes. OneNote import support. Works across Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex.
